notes.title: Connection Issue
notes.content:
Dear Steam Players

Please be adviced that as of the 27/72024 at 9am the twitch connection website that we use to connect our games to twitch chat is down we are working to have this fixed with in the next 2 weeks - 1 month we are doing big testing on our new system we are working on.

Anyone who is already connected to the twitch connection part please be advice you are still able to play the game/s this is just for new users.

We have informed twitch about this service being down and we have also contacted steam to make them aware.

We will be doing a update to all games over the next coming weeks to make this working again and be doing testing every day from now to make sure we have the twitch connection server working the way it should be and not causing any issues.

If you want to hear more as we update please join our [url=https://discord.gg/KqQsCUte2N]Discord[/url]


We thank you for your understanding and hope to have things back to normal as fast as we can

Regards
Alley Catz Games Dev Team
